erp.description: Equity risk premium in % (default 5.5 — Damodaran mature market ERP). Override for emerging market exposure.

growth_rate.description: Annual FCF growth rate for 5-year projection in % (e.g. 15.0 = 15%). Overrides auto-detected analyst consensus EPS CAGR. Default: analyst 5Y consensus or FCF 3Y CAGR.

terminal_growth_rate.description: Perpetuity growth rate after year 5 in % (default 3.0 — long-run GDP growth). Use 2.0–3.5 for mature companies, 0–2.0 for declining businesses.

ticker.description: US stock ticker (e.g. AAPL, NVDA, MSFT). Case-insensitive.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection. Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.025 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. 5-year Discounted Cash Flow model for any US public company. Fetches free cash flow history, consensus EPS growth, and WACC (CAPM), then projects 5 years of FCF, adds a Gordon Growth terminal value, subtracts net debt, and divides by diluted shares to produce intrinsic value per share vs current price. Returns margin of safety, upside/downside %, and full DCF schedule. No API key required.

name: dcf-valuation

dcf_schedule.description: Projected FCF and present value by year.

fcf_history.description: Historical free cash flows (operating CF − capex) by fiscal year.

margin_of_safety_pct.description: Margin of safety: (intrinsic − price) / intrinsic × 100. Positive = undervalued, negative = overvalued.

upside_pct.description: Upside from current price to intrinsic value in %.

verdict.description: UNDERVALUED | FAIRLY_VALUED | OVERVALUED based on margin of safety.
